apps.name: Wasl
apps.subtitle: Chat with friends nearby, no internet needed
apps.localizedDescription: Offline Telegram-style messenger over Bluetooth and Wi-Fi. Messages hop phone to phone, end-to-end encrypted. Works with Android and iPhone.

versions.localizedDescription: Wasl 0.4: Phone repeater. Nearby phones relay your messages and files to contacts out of range, across chains of up to 4 phones (on by default, Settings → Phone repeater). Files now download from several phones at once and every piece is verified.

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Wasl uses Bluetooth to find friends nearby and deliver messages without internet.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Wasl uses the local Wi-Fi network for fast file transfers between nearby phones.
